title: T018 outbox operationalisation tests-first boundary
summary: The T018 operationalisation slice is bounded to explicit event-type registration, worker-only scheduling and redacted outbox metrics behind courtside.outbox.enabled. The tests-first branch is confirmed red at PR #52 head 2abbe88 because the new runtime boundary is not implemented yet; implementation remains the next action and production activation/merge remain human gates.

claims.text: PR #52 head 2abbe882 fails the intended tests-first compilation boundary because the explicit handler registry, scheduler, metrics adapters, worker configuration split and Micrometer dependency are absent.

The T018 enhancement must not invent a concrete domain handler, change V001/schema, add a broker/provider, access credentials, expose management endpoints or enable courtside.outbox.enabled in deployment configuration.

The next bounded action is to implement exact event-type registration, worker-profile scheduling with lifecycle controls and redacted Micrometer metrics while preserving the existing direct OutboxWorker test constructor.

decision.context: T018 is merged on main but its completion receipt explicitly leaves handler registration, scheduling and operational metrics as follow-up boundaries.
decision.chosen: Implement only the opt-in operational boundary and require exact-head CI/Security plus human protected-merge review before treating it as production-ready.
alternatives: Add a catch-all handler or silently dispatch unknown event types.
Enable the worker or management endpoints through deployment configuration.
Combine this slice with schema, broker, provider or T021 shared observability work.
tradeoffs: The runtime wiring is explicit and auditable but requires each concrete domain handler to register separately later.
The worker can be enabled only with deliberate profile/configuration choices; this slice does not activate it.
Outbox-specific metrics improve diagnosis without making payload, aggregate or credential data observable.
decision.invalidation: If the T018 API, V001 schema, task scope or security policy changes, mark this record needs_update and stop before widening the implementation boundary.
decision.proof: CI #155 and Security #155 independently stop at the expected missing-runtime-symbol compile boundary on PR #52 head 2abbe882; the failure is recorded without storing raw logs.
